_readme: Translator context notes. Same namespace/key structure as en.json. Values describe where the string appears, its tone, interpolation variables, and any caveats.

app._context: Shown as a fullscreen splash screen while the app boots.
app.initializing: Single word loading label shown in large text.
app.firstTimeMessage: Secondary hint shown below the loading label on first launch only.

acceptShareDialog._context: Modal dialog opened via menu > 'Accept Share'. User pastes a one-time code sent by another user to receive a shared note.
acceptShareDialog.title: Dialog title.
acceptShareDialog.enterCode: Instruction label above the code input field.
acceptShareDialog.warning: Yellow/orange warning text. Security advisory — keep the tone cautionary but not alarming.
acceptShareDialog.noShareFound: Error shown after submitting a code that doesn't match any pending share.
acceptShareDialog.cannotAcceptNoteCount: Error shown if accepting would exceed the note count limit. Variables: {count} = number of new notes, {max} = current limit. Contains a newline (\n).
acceptShareDialog.cannotAcceptDataUsage: Error shown if accepting would exceed data storage limit. Variables: {size} = human-readable data size of new notes, {max} = current limit. Contains a newline (\n).
acceptShareDialog.limitExceeded: Generic limit error wrapper. Variable: {message} = the specific limit message.

checkUpdateDialog._context: Small dialog shown when the user manually checks for updates via menu.
checkUpdateDialog.title: Uses the app name 'Mimiri Notes' as title — do not translate the product name.
checkUpdateDialog.noUpdateFound: Shown when already on the latest version.
checkUpdateDialog.updateFound: Shown when a newer version is available. Variable: {version} = version string e.g. '2.6.1'.

deleteHistoryDialog._context: Confirmation dialog for deleting version history of a note. Opened from note properties.
deleteHistoryDialog.title: Dialog title.
deleteHistoryDialog.deleteAll: Question shown when deleting the entire history. No question mark in English — match same punctuation style.
deleteHistoryDialog.deleteOlder: Question shown when deleting only old entries (keeping the 10 most recent).
deleteHistoryDialog.keepRecent: Parenthetical clarification shown below deleteOlder. Describes what will be retained.
deleteHistoryDialog.sharedWith: Label shown when the note is shared — followed by a list of usernames.
deleteHistoryDialog.otherUsers: Shown when there are too many shared users to list individually. Variable: {count} = number of other users.

deleteLocalDataDialog._context: Dialog shown when the user logs out, offering to wipe locally cached (encrypted) data. Shown especially on shared/non-personal devices.
deleteLocalDataDialog.title: Dialog title.
deleteLocalDataDialog.question: Primary question to the user.
deleteLocalDataDialog.moreInfo: Inline link that expands an explanation panel.
deleteLocalDataDialog.notPersonalDevice: Advice sentence — recommends deleting if not on a personal machine.
deleteLocalDataDialog.leaveImprovePerformance: Counter-argument — keeping data improves next login performance.
deleteLocalDataDialog.encryptedWarning: Security note. Data is encrypted but local presence is still a risk.
deleteLocalDataDialog.removeData: Button to wipe local cache and log out.
deleteLocalDataDialog.justLogOut: Button to log out without deleting local data.

deleteMethodDialog._context: Confirmation dialog when deleting a saved payment method (credit card etc.).
deleteMethodDialog.title: Dialog title.
deleteMethodDialog.question: Question shown above the payment method name (appended separately).

deleteNodeDialog._context: Confirmation dialog shown when deleting a note or leaving a shared note. Has three modes: delete, leave share, or cannot-delete error.
deleteNodeDialog.deleteTitle: Title when deleting a note the user owns.
deleteNodeDialog.leaveShareTitle: Title when removing a shared note (user does not own it, they leave the share).
deleteNodeDialog.cannotDeleteTitle: Title when deletion is blocked because the note contains shared sub-notes.
deleteNodeDialog.deleteQuestion: Question shown in delete mode — note name appended after.
deleteNodeDialog.leaveQuestion: Question shown in leave-share mode — share name appended after.
deleteNodeDialog.noOtherUsers: Info line: no other user will be affected by the deletion.
deleteNodeDialog.remainAccessible: Info line: the note will still be accessible to the listed users after deletion by this user.
deleteNodeDialog.alsoDeleted: Warning line: deleting this note will also remove it for these other users.
deleteNodeDialog.cannotDeleteLine1: First line of the error explanation for the cannot-delete case.
deleteNodeDialog.cannotDeleteLine2: Second line of the error explanation — instructs the user what to do first.
deleteNodeDialog.otherUsers: Compact count when too many co-users to list. Variable: {count}.
deleteNodeDialog.ok: Dismiss button for the cannot-delete error case.

emptyRecycleBinDialog._context: Confirmation dialog to permanently destroy all notes in the recycle bin.
emptyRecycleBinDialog.title: Dialog title.
emptyRecycleBinDialog.question: Confirmation question. 'Permanently' is important — keep that nuance.

inconsistencyDialog._context: Dialog shown after sync detects and auto-repairs a data inconsistency. Rare edge case.
inconsistencyDialog.title: Dialog title.
inconsistencyDialog.reloadRecommended: Advice to reload the app for safety.

infoDialog._context: Generic informational dialog with a single dismiss button. Used throughout the app.

limitDialog._context: Dialog shown when an operation is blocked because a quota limit has been reached.
limitDialog.noteCountTitle: Title when note count limit hit.
limitDialog.noteCountText: Body text for note count limit. Variables: {count} = notes created, {max} = limit.
limitDialog.dataSizeTitle: Title when data storage limit hit.
limitDialog.dataSizeText: Body text for data limit. Variables: {used} = human-readable used size, {max} = limit.
limitDialog.noteSizeTitle: Title when a single note exceeds its size cap.
limitDialog.noteSizeText: Body text for single-note size limit. Variables: {size} = note size, {max} = max allowed.

loginDialog._context: Re-authentication dialog shown when the session token has expired (e.g. user changed password on another device). NOT the initial login screen.
loginDialog.title: Dialog title.
loginDialog.serverIndicator: Appended to the title when authenticating against the server specifically, e.g. 'Login (Server)'.
loginDialog.serverReauth: Explanatory sentence shown above the form.
loginDialog.username: Label for the username input field.
loginDialog.password: Label for the password input field.
loginDialog.capsLock: Warning shown when Caps Lock is active. Exclamation mark kept for urgency.
loginDialog.incorrectCredentials: Validation error shown after a failed login attempt.
loginDialog.pleaseWait: Loading state label shown while the auth request is in progress.
loginDialog.whySeeingThis: Expandable section header — clicking shows the three 'reason' items.
loginDialog.reason1: Bullet point: password changed on another device.
loginDialog.reason2: Bullet point: upgraded from an old version.
loginDialog.reason3: Bullet point: catch-all for unexpected errors.

passwordDialog._context: Dialog that asks the user to confirm their current password before a sensitive action (e.g. changing password, deleting account).
passwordDialog.title: Dialog title.
passwordDialog.capsLock: Warning shown when Caps Lock is active.
passwordDialog.incorrectPassword: Validation error after a wrong password.

passwordGeneratorDialog._context: Standalone dialog version of the password generator (also embedded inline elsewhere).
passwordGeneratorDialog.title: Dialog title.
passwordGeneratorDialog.howCalculated: Link/button that opens a detailed explanation of the entropy calculation.
passwordGeneratorDialog.password: Label above the generated password display.
passwordGeneratorDialog.copy: Button to copy the password to clipboard.

saveEmptyNodeDialog._context: Confirmation dialog asking whether to save a note with empty content.
saveEmptyNodeDialog.title: Dialog title.
saveEmptyNodeDialog.question: Confirmation question — note name appended after.

shareDialog._context: Dialog for sharing a note with another user. Has two phases: (1) enter the other user's username; (2) display the one-time code for them to use.
shareDialog.title: Dialog title.
shareDialog.codeInstruction: Instruction shown in phase 2 with the generated code. Variables: {name} = recipient username, {noteName} = note name.
shareDialog.acceptInstruction: Follow-up instruction telling the sharer what the recipient needs to do. Variable: {name} = recipient username. The menu item name 'Accept Share' should match the contextMenu.acceptShare translation.
shareDialog.loseCodeHint: Hint explaining what to do if the code is lost. Variables: {noteName}, {name}.
shareDialog.multipleUsersHint: Hint that the process must be repeated per recipient.
shareDialog.shareWith: Label above the username input in phase 1. Variables: {noteName} = note being shared.
shareDialog.invalidUsername: Validation error when the username field is empty.
shareDialog.shareWithSelf: Error when user tries to share with their own username.
shareDialog.shareFailed: Error when the share request fails (network/server error).
shareDialog.enterUsernameHint: Help text below the input in phase 1. Variable: {noteName}.
shareDialog.codeHint: Help text describing what to do with the code once it appears.
shareDialog.copied: Transient label shown briefly after the copy button is clicked.
shareDialog.copy: Button to copy the one-time code.

syncErrorDialog._context: Dialog shown when background sync fails. Different title/body shown depending on the error type.
syncErrorDialog.noteLimitTitle: Title for note count quota error.
syncErrorDialog.noteLimitText: Body for note count error. Variables: {count}, {max}. Contains newline.
syncErrorDialog.dataLimitTitle: Title for data storage quota error.
syncErrorDialog.dataLimitText: Body for data storage error. Variables: {used}, {max}. Contains double newline.
syncErrorDialog.noteSizeLimitText: Body for note size error. Variables: {title} = note name, {size}, {max}. Contains multiple newlines. The note name is wrapped in curly quotes in English — use local typographic quote convention.
syncErrorDialog.syncErrorText: Body for generic error. Contains newlines.
syncErrorDialog.serverRejectionText: Body for server rejection (usually a temporary issue). Contains newlines.
syncErrorDialog.show: Button to show the affected note.
syncErrorDialog.upgrade: Button to go to the upgrade/plan page.

convertAccount._context: Screen shown while converting a local account to a cloud account. Shows progress.
convertAccount.title: Screen title.
convertAccount.nodesConverted: Progress counter. Variable: {count} = number of notes converted so far.

lockScreen._context: Lock screen shown after a period of inactivity when a PIN is set. Covers the entire app.
lockScreen.enterPin: Instruction shown above the PIN input.
lockScreen.attemptsRemaining: Warning shown when the user has only 1 attempt left before lockout. The '1' is hardcoded — this string only appears at 1 remaining attempt.

mainToolbar._context: Tooltip text for the icon buttons in the main toolbar (top of the app, mobile and web).
mainToolbar.newRootNote: Tooltip: create a note at the top level of the tree.
mainToolbar.newChildNote: Tooltip: create a note as a child of the selected note.
mainToolbar.newSiblingNote: Tooltip: create a note at the same level as the selected note.

noteEditor._context: Toolbar buttons and labels in the note editor pane.
noteEditor.back: Mobile back button to return to the note list.
noteEditor.saveNote: Tooltip/button to save the current note.
noteEditor.hideHistory: Toggle button label when history panel is open.
noteEditor.showHistory: Toggle button label when history panel is closed.
noteEditor.markAsPassword: Toolbar button tooltip — formats selected text as masked password text. Keyboard shortcut is appended in the English string.
noteEditor.heading: Toolbar button: insert/format a heading.
noteEditor.codeBlock: Toolbar button: insert a code block.
noteEditor.list: Toolbar button: insert an unordered list.
noteEditor.orderedList: Toolbar button: insert an ordered/numbered list.
noteEditor.disableWordWrap: Toggle button shown when word wrap is currently on.
noteEditor.enableWordWrap: Toggle button shown when word wrap is currently off.
noteEditor.toggleEditMode: Button to switch between edit and preview/read-only mode.
noteEditor.readOnly: Badge/label appended to note title when the note is read-only (e.g. during conflict resolution).
noteEditor.historyEntries: Label shown above the history entry count in the history panel.
noteEditor.readMoreEntries: Button at the bottom of history list to load older entries.

noteTreeView._context: The hierarchical note tree on the left side of the app.
noteTreeView.noResultsFound: Empty-state text shown in the tree when a search yields no matches.

notificationList._context: Notification panel that shows system and share notifications.
notificationList.markAllRead: Button to dismiss all unread notifications.

recycleBin._context: The recycle bin node shown at the bottom of the note tree.
recycleBin.recycleBin: Display name of the Recycle Bin tree node.

selectionControl._context: Context menu shown on text selection in mobile/web (no right-click).

titleBar._context: The title bar / OS menu bar across the top of the desktop app (Electron). Also used for the web top bar. 'file', 'edit', 'view', 'tools', 'help' are the OS menu categories — use the conventional menu names for the target OS/locale.
titleBar.searchNotes: Placeholder text in the top search bar.
titleBar.screenSharingVisible: Warning badge shown in title bar when screen privacy is OFF (note content visible to screen capture). Keep 'Warning:' prominent.
titleBar.screenSharingHidden: Status badge shown when screen privacy is ON (note content hidden from screen capture).
titleBar.notifications: Tooltip for the notification bell icon.
titleBar.accountOffline: Account icon tooltip when the app is offline.
titleBar.accountOnline: Account icon tooltip when connected and syncing.
titleBar.accountConnecting: Account icon tooltip while establishing connection.

conflictBanner._context: Banner shown at the top of the editor when a note has unresolved sync conflicts. The editor is read-only until all conflicts are resolved.
conflictBanner.conflicts: Main conflict count message. Variable: {count} = number of conflicts.
conflictBanner.previous: Navigation button to jump to the previous conflict in the document. The '←' arrow is part of the string.
conflictBanner.next: Navigation button to jump to the next conflict. The '→' arrow is part of the string.

statusBar._context: Status text shown at the very bottom of the app window.
statusBar.offline: Shown when there is no internet connection.
statusBar.notLoggedIn: Shown when no account is authenticated.
statusBar.synchronizing: Shown while sync is in progress.
statusBar.syncError: Generic sync error — clickable to see details.
statusBar.syncErrorNoteSize: Sync error variant: a note exceeds its size limit.
statusBar.syncErrorServerRejection: Sync error variant: the server rejected the request.

textNoteProperties._context: The Properties tab/panel shown in the right sidebar when a note is selected.
textNoteProperties.data: Label for current encrypted note data size.
textNoteProperties.history: Label for the storage used by version history.
textNoteProperties.total: Label for the combined data + history size.
textNoteProperties.created: Label for the note creation date.
textNoteProperties.key: Label for the note's encryption key ID (technical, shown for debugging).
textNoteProperties.deleteOldHistory: Button to delete history older than the 10 most recent versions.
textNoteProperties.deleteAllHistory: Button to delete all version history.
textNoteProperties.sharedWith: Label above the list of users this note is shared with.
textNoteProperties.noOneAccepted: Shown when the note has been shared (code sent) but no recipient has accepted yet.

settingsAbout._context: The 'About' tab in the settings panel. Shows version info, links, and debug tools.
settingsAbout.bundleVersion: Label for the web bundle version.
settingsAbout.hostVersion: Label for the Electron host version (desktop only).
settingsAbout.spaceUsed: Label for the total storage used.
settingsAbout.unsyncedNotes: Label for notes not yet synced to the server.
settingsAbout.unsyncedData: Label for data not yet synced.
settingsAbout.termsAndConditions: Hyperlink label to the Terms & Conditions page.
settingsAbout.privacyPolicy: Hyperlink label to the Privacy Policy page.
settingsAbout.discord: Hyperlink label to join the Discord server.
settingsAbout.reddit: Hyperlink label to join the Reddit community.
settingsAbout.sourceGitHub: Hyperlink label to the GitHub source repository.
settingsAbout.issueTracker: Hyperlink label to the GitHub issue tracker.
settingsAbout.fontLicensesText: Explanatory text for font licenses. Contains a newline.
settingsAbout.chooseFontLicense: Placeholder/instruction for a font selector that shows the license.
settingsAbout.projectLink: Label before the project URL for a selected font.
settingsAbout.closeLog: Button to close the debug log panel.
settingsAbout.reload: Button to reload the app (used for troubleshooting).
settingsAbout.enableDebug: Button to turn on debug logging.
settingsAbout.disableDebug: Button to turn off debug logging.

settingsDeleteAccount._context: Dangerous account deletion settings tab. Has a checklist of acknowledgements the user must tick before the delete button activates.
settingsDeleteAccount.iUnderstandThat: Preamble before the three checkbox labels — 'I understand that'.
settingsDeleteAccount.permanentlyDeleteAccount: Checkbox 1 text (completing the 'I understand that...' sentence).
settingsDeleteAccount.password: Label for the password confirmation field.
settingsDeleteAccount.alsoDeleteLocal: Checkbox to also wipe local cached data from this device.
settingsDeleteAccount.capsLock: Warning when Caps Lock is on.
settingsDeleteAccount.pleaseWait: Loading state while deletion is in progress.
settingsDeleteAccount.deleteAccount: The destructive delete button (only enabled when all checkboxes are ticked and password is correct).
settingsDeleteAccount.invalidPassword: Error shown when the entered password is wrong.
settingsDeleteAccount.passwordRequired: Validation error shown when the password field is empty.

settingsPinCode._context: Settings tab to set a 4-digit PIN for quick re-entry after the app locks due to inactivity.
settingsPinCode.setOrChangeTooltip: Tooltip explaining the PIN feature in detail.
settingsPinCode.clear: Button to remove the existing PIN.
settingsPinCode.save: Button to save the new PIN.

settingsGeneral._context: General settings tab. Desktop (Electron) only for most options. Tooltips appear on hover over each toggle.
settingsGeneral.language: Section label for the UI language selector.
settingsGeneral.languageEnglish: Language option label for English. Always the native name only ('English') across all locales — language picker shows each language in its own script so users can recognise their language regardless of the current UI language.
settingsGeneral.languageChinese: Language option label for Chinese. Always the native name only ('中文') across all locales.
settingsGeneral.languageDanish: Language option label for Danish. Always the native name only ('Dansk') across all locales.
settingsGeneral.languageGerman: Language option label for German. Always the native name only ('Deutsch') across all locales.
settingsGeneral.theme: Section label for the theme selector.
settingsGeneral.themeSystem: Theme option: follow the OS dark/light setting.
settingsGeneral.trayIcon: Section label for the tray icon color selector.
settingsGeneral.trayIconSystem: Tray icon option: auto-match OS theme.
settingsGeneral.launchOnLogin: Toggle label: auto-start Mimiri on OS login.
settingsGeneral.showInTaskbar: Toggle label: show window in taskbar.
settingsGeneral.keepTrayVisible: Toggle label: keep the Windows System Tray (systray) icon visible — prevent it from being auto-hidden into the overflow area.
settingsGeneral.keepTrayVisibleTooltip: Tooltip for keepTrayVisible. 'Tray Icon' refers to the Windows System Tray (systray) icon.
settingsGeneral.quitOnClose: Toggle label: fully quit instead of minimise to tray when closing.
settingsGeneral.useChevrons: Toggle label: show > chevron icons instead of +/- in the note tree.
settingsGeneral.showVerticalGuides: Toggle label: show vertical indent guide lines in the tree.
settingsGeneral.disableDevBlog: Toggle label: hide the dev blog section from the control panel.

settingsPassword._context: Change password settings tab for cloud accounts.
settingsPassword.generate: Button to generate a new password using the password generator.
settingsPassword.create: Button to confirm and save the new password.
settingsPassword.generated: Label shown next to the generated password preview.
settingsPassword.new: Label for the 'new password' input field.
settingsPassword.repeat: Label for the 'confirm password' input field.
settingsPassword.iterations: Label for the PBKDF2 iteration count selector.
settingsPassword.matching: Inline status: the two password fields match.
settingsPassword.notMatching: Inline status: the two password fields do not match.
settingsPassword.notReallyAPassword: Strength indicator: password is too weak to be useful.
settingsPassword.capsLock: Warning when Caps Lock is on.
settingsPassword.option1M: Iteration count option: 1 million. Variable: {time} = estimated time to log in on this device. '(default)' marks the recommended option.

settingsPromoteAccount._context: Settings tab shown to users with a local account, letting them add a username/password to make it a cloud account.
settingsPromoteAccount.description: Short introductory sentence at the top of the tab.
settingsPromoteAccount.repeat: Label for the repeat password field.
settingsPromoteAccount.iterations: Label for the iteration count selector.
settingsPromoteAccount.noRecoveryWarning: Checkbox the user must tick — acknowledges that innonova cannot recover their password. Contains <b> HTML tags for bold formatting — preserve them.

settingsCreateAccount2._context: The new account creation screen. Has two tabs: Cloud Account and Local Account. Includes a feature list and FAQs. This is a marketing-oriented screen — tone should be clear and welcoming.
settingsCreateAccount2.cloudAccountHeader: Section header inside the cloud tab.
settingsCreateAccount2.localAccountHeader: Section header inside the local tab.
settingsCreateAccount2.cloudFeature1..11: Bullet-point feature list for cloud account. Keep each item concise.
settingsCreateAccount2.localFeature1..5: Bullet-point feature list for local account.
settingsCreateAccount2.chooseCredentials: Section heading above the username/password form.
settingsCreateAccount2.repeat: Field label for the repeat/confirm password.
settingsCreateAccount2.hideGenerator: Button to collapse the inline password generator.
settingsCreateAccount2.helpMeChoose: Button to expand the inline password generator.
settingsCreateAccount2.readMoreSecurity: Link to a security explainer on mimiri.io.
settingsCreateAccount2.readMorePassword: Link to a password selection explainer on mimiri.io.
settingsCreateAccount2.faq2Answer: FAQ accordion item — answer. Contains double newlines.
settingsCreateAccount2.faq4Answer: FAQ accordion item — answer. Contains newline.
settingsCreateAccount2.faq5Answer: FAQ accordion item — answer. Contains newlines.

settingsUpgrade._context: Settings tab for upgrading a local account to a cloud account.
settingsUpgrade.currentLocalUser: Label showing the current local username.
settingsUpgrade.username: Field label for the desired cloud username.
settingsUpgrade.currentPassword: Field label for the existing local account password.
settingsUpgrade.chooseNewPassword: Section heading above the new password fields.
settingsUpgrade.incorrectPassword: Error when the current password is wrong.
settingsUpgrade.upgradeError: Generic error shown if the upgrade fails server-side.

settingsFontsColors._context: Settings tab for customising the editor font and colour theme.
settingsFontsColors.editor: Section heading for editor font settings.
settingsFontsColors.fontFamily: Label for the font family dropdown.
settingsFontsColors.custom: Option in the font family dropdown for entering a custom font name.
settingsFontsColors.nameOfFont: Help text shown when 'Custom' font is selected.
settingsFontsColors.fontName: Label for the custom font name input.
settingsFontsColors.fontSize: Label for the font size input.
settingsFontsColors.theme: Label for the editor colour theme dropdown.
settingsFontsColors.auto: Theme option: automatically follow the OS light/dark mode.
settingsFontsColors.restoreDefaults: Button to reset all font/theme settings to defaults.
settingsFontsColors.normalText: Preview text label — shows normal text in the current font.

settingsRecycleBin._context: Settings tab for managing the recycle bin.
settingsRecycleBin.description: Short description at the top of the tab.
settingsRecycleBin.scanForInconsistencies: Button to scan for and fix data inconsistencies.
settingsRecycleBin.emptyRecycleBin: Button to permanently delete all items in the recycle bin.

settingsUsername._context: Settings tab to change the account username.

settingsUpdate._context: Settings tab for configuring the auto-update behaviour. Has a mode selector and a large descriptive section that changes based on the selected mode. The 'desc*' keys are contextual description paragraphs, not labels.
settingsUpdate.autoIdle: Update mode: update automatically when the app is idle.
settingsUpdate.autoStart: Update mode: update automatically on app startup.
settingsUpdate.strongNotify: Update mode: manual, with a prominent notification.
settingsUpdate.discreteNotify: Update mode: manual, with a subtle notification.
settingsUpdate.off: Update mode: no updates at all.
settingsUpdate.descNoRestartAuto: Description paragraph: explains that non-restart updates happen silently when idle.
settingsUpdate.descIosAppStore: Description: iOS larger updates go through AppStore.
settingsUpdate.descAndroidPlay: Description: Android larger updates go through Google Play.
settingsUpdate.descMacWinRestart: Description: restart-required updates apply on next app restart.
settingsUpdate.descLinuxFlatHub: Description: FlatHub/Snap users get host updates through normal flow.
settingsUpdate.descLinuxManual: Description: manual Linux install users get a notification for host updates.
settingsUpdate.descPreservePosition: Description: current tree/note position is preserved across updates.
settingsUpdate.descNoUnsaved: Description: updates are blocked if there is unsaved data.
settingsUpdate.descSeamless: Description: the update experience is designed to be seamless.
settingsUpdate.descOnRestart: Description: updates apply on next restart.
settingsUpdate.descNotificationShown: Description intro: 'Notification will be shown like this' — followed by inline UI examples.
settingsUpdate.descInTitlebar: Description continuation: '...in the titlebar and like this'.
settingsUpdate.descInSystemArea: Description continuation: '...in the System area in the treeview'.
settingsUpdate.descManualPerform: Description: update can then be triggered manually from this page.
settingsUpdate.descNoNotification: Description: no notification shown; user must check manually.
settingsUpdate.descFlatHubStill: Description: FlatHub/Snap host updates still go through normal flow.
settingsUpdate.descIosStill: Description: AppStore updates still happen (outside developer control).
settingsUpdate.descAndroidStill: Description: Google Play updates still happen (outside developer control).
settingsUpdate.noUpdatesFound: Status: already on the latest version.
settingsUpdate.latestVersion: Label for the latest available version.
settingsUpdate.newVersion: Label for the new version being offered.
settingsUpdate.checkForUpdates: Button to manually trigger an update check.
settingsUpdate.updateAvailable: Status badge: a newer version is available.
settingsUpdate.restartToActivate: Status after installation — app needs a restart.
settingsUpdate.restart: Button to restart and activate the update.
settingsUpdate.electronClientRequired: Status: a new Electron host client is required (larger update).
settingsUpdate.directDownload: Label before the direct download link.
settingsUpdate.newInUpdate: Section heading for the release notes.
settingsUpdate.version: Label before the version number in the release notes.
settingsUpdate.newFeaturesAndChanges: Sub-heading for new features in the release notes.
settingsUpdate.fixes: Sub-heading for bug fixes in the release notes.

settingsExplainPlan._context: Settings tab that shows the current subscription plan details.

subSubscriptionItem._context: A single subscription line item shown in the plan overview. Shows plan name, period, and action buttons.
subSubscriptionItem.perMonth: Period suffix: '/month' — appended directly to price. Translate the word, keep the '/' prefix if conventional in the target language.
subSubscriptionItem.endsOn: Label: the plan ends on a date (non-renewing).
subSubscriptionItem.endedOn: Label: the plan has already ended.
subSubscriptionItem.renewsAutomatically: Label: the plan auto-renews on a date.
subSubscriptionItem.paymentOverdue: Warning badge: payment is past due.
subSubscriptionItem.payNow: Button: pay the overdue amount now.
subSubscriptionItem.upgrade: Button: upgrade to a higher plan.
subSubscriptionItem.change: Button: change to a different plan.
subSubscriptionItem.changeTo: Button: change to this specific plan.

subUpgradeView._context: View shown during the upgrade flow: confirms the chosen plan before payment.
subUpgradeView.chosenPlan: Section heading for the plan summary.
subUpgradeView.change: Button to go back and change the plan.
subUpgradeView.billingAddress: Section heading for the billing address block.

subWaitingForPayment._context: View shown while waiting for a payment to complete in an external browser window (redirect-based payment flow).
subWaitingForPayment.waitingBrowser: Status message: waiting for the browser window to complete.
subWaitingForPayment.noWindowOpened: Hint shown if the browser window didn't open automatically.
subWaitingForPayment.waitingAutomatic: Status message for automatic/webhook payment confirmation.
subWaitingForPayment.check: Button to manually check payment status.

subPaymentMethods._context: List of saved payment methods (credit cards etc.).
subPaymentMethods.createNew: Button to add a new payment method.

subPaymentMethodItem._context: A single saved payment method row.
subPaymentMethodItem.expires: Label before the expiry date of the card.
subPaymentMethodItem.makeDefault: Button to set this method as the default.
subPaymentMethodItem.default: Badge marking the current default payment method.
subPaymentMethodItem.delete: Button to delete this payment method.

subPaymentMethodSelector._context: Dropdown/dialog for choosing which payment method to use at checkout.
subPaymentMethodSelector.createNew: Option to add a new payment method.

subPaymentSummary._context: Payment summary panel shown at checkout. Includes terms acceptance checkboxes.
subPaymentSummary.items: Sub-heading for the list of line items.
subPaymentSummary.total: Label for the total amount due.
subPaymentSummary.vat: Label for the VAT portion of the total.
subPaymentSummary.acceptTerms: Text before the Terms & Conditions hyperlink in the checkbox label.
subPaymentSummary.termsAndConditions: The hyperlink text in the Terms checkbox.
subPaymentSummary.acceptPrivacy: Text before the Privacy Policy hyperlink in the checkbox label.
subPaymentSummary.privacyPolicy: The hyperlink text in the Privacy checkbox.

subCustomerData._context: Billing information form. Fields marked '*' are required for VAT invoice purposes.
subCustomerData.firstName: Field label — includes the * required marker.
subCustomerData.verified: Inline status: email has been verified.
subCustomerData.verificationSent: Inline status: verification email was sent.
subCustomerData.sendVerification: Button to send a verification email.
subCustomerData.stateProvince: Field label — optional, used in some countries.
subCustomerData.required: Legend below the form explaining the * marker.
subCustomerData.recommendFillOut: Advisory note encouraging full form completion for tax invoice.
subCustomerData.whyAskInfo:
Long HTML privacy explanation text. Contains
, , and an link — preserve all HTML tags. The URL must not be changed.

subInvoiceItem._context: A single invoice row in the invoice list.
subInvoiceItem.paid: Status badge: invoice is paid. In English shown in UPPERCASE — match local convention.
subInvoiceItem.open: Status badge: invoice is unpaid and due.
subInvoiceItem.overdue: Status badge: invoice is past due.
subInvoiceItem.credited: Status badge: invoice has been credited/refunded.
subInvoiceItem.creditNote: Status badge: this entry is a credit note.
subInvoiceItem.willBePaidAutomatically: Hint shown on open invoices covered by auto-pay — followed by a date.
subInvoiceItem.payNow: Button to manually pay an open invoice.
subInvoiceItem.view: Button to view the invoice detail page.
subInvoiceItem.pdf: Button to download the PDF version.

subNewSubscriptionView._context: The main subscription/plan overview page. Shows available plans and FAQs. Marketing tone — friendly and honest.
subNewSubscriptionView.promoCopy: Marketing copy below the plan cards. Contains a newline. Keep the tone genuine and supportive rather than salesy.
subNewSubscriptionView.faq1Question: FAQ: is the free tier really free?

passwordInput._context: Inline strength indicator shown below password fields throughout the app.

passwordRepeatInput._context: Inline match indicator shown below the 'Repeat password' field.
passwordRepeatInput.notMatching: The two passwords do not match.

usernameInput._context: Inline status shown below username fields while availability is being checked.
usernameInput.current: Username is the user's current username (no change).
usernameInput.checking: Checking availability with the server (loading state).
usernameInput.invalid: Username format is invalid (too short, illegal characters, etc.).

passwordGenerator._context: The inline and standalone password generator component. Has a preset selector, character options, and a detailed security analysis panel.
passwordGenerator.nudgeUp: Preset option: slightly stronger than recommended — colloquial tone.
passwordGenerator.poorMemory: Preset option: generates a more memorable password — colloquial/humorous tone.
passwordGenerator.imATarget: Preset option: high-security setting — for users who expect to be targeted.
passwordGenerator.cosplayMataHari: Preset option: maximum security — humorous/dramatic tone. Mata Hari was a spy; this implies espionage-level secrecy.
passwordGenerator.easierToType: Preset option: optimises for typing ease over strength.
passwordGenerator.includeLowerCase: Checkbox: include lowercase letters in the character set.
passwordGenerator.includeFriendlySymbols: Checkbox: include common symbols (~!@#$ etc.) that are easy to type.
passwordGenerator.includeExactlyOneSymbol: Checkbox: exactly 1 symbol character in the password (some sites require this).
passwordGenerator.numberOfCharacters: Label for the character length slider/input.
passwordGenerator.workFactor: Label for the PBKDF2 iteration count selector.
passwordGenerator.option1M: Iteration option: 1 million. Variable: {time} = estimated login time.
passwordGenerator.timeToLogin: Label for the estimated login time stat.
passwordGenerator.possibleCombinations: Label for the possible combinations count.
passwordGenerator.howLikelyToBeCracked: Section heading for the cracking probability analysis.
passwordGenerator.largeScaleBreach: Sub-label: probability in a large-scale password database breach.
passwordGenerator.targetedAttack: Sub-label: probability under a targeted attack.
passwordGenerator.investmentRequired: Section heading for the cost-to-crack analysis.
passwordGenerator.oneYear: Sub-label: cost to crack within 1 year.
passwordGenerator.oneMonth: Sub-label: cost to crack within 1 month.
passwordGenerator.oneWeek: Sub-label: cost to crack within 1 week.
passwordGenerator.showDetails: Link/button to expand the detailed security analysis panel.
passwordGenerator.hideDetails: Link/button to collapse the analysis panel.
passwordGenerator.notHappening: Cracking probability result: essentially impossible given current computing.
passwordGenerator.certainty: Cracking probability result: nearly certain to be cracked.
passwordGenerator.likely: Cracking probability result: likely to be cracked.
passwordGenerator.unknown: Cracking probability result: cannot be determined.
passwordGenerator.onlineAttack: Analysis sub-section: probability via online brute-force attacking the live server.
passwordGenerator.dataBreach: Analysis sub-section: probability if the hashed password database is leaked.

common._context: General-purpose strings reused across the app.
common.expand: Tooltip/label to expand a collapsible section.

settingsDevBlog._context: Developer blog section in the control panel.

autoComplete._context: Autocomplete dropdown used in search and note-linking fields.
autoComplete.noResults: Empty-state text when no suggestions match.

controlPanel._context: The left-side control panel tree. These are node labels displayed in the navigation tree (similar to a file tree). Keep them short.
controlPanel.connectCloud: Tree node: Connect to Cloud (upgrade from local).
controlPanel.createPassword: Tree node: Create Password (set password on a local account).
controlPanel.loading: Shown while the control panel tree is loading.

editor._context: Buttons shown directly in the editor as inline code lens actions or conflict resolution controls.
editor.keepLocal: Conflict resolution button: keep the local version of this conflict block.
editor.keepServer: Conflict resolution button: keep the server version.
editor.keepBoth: Conflict resolution button: keep both versions (merge).
editor.copyBlock: Code lens button shown above a code block: copy the entire block to clipboard.
editor.selectBlock: Code lens button: select all text in the code block.
editor.copyNextLine: Code lens button: copy only the next line of the code block.

contextMenu._context: Right-click context menu items and OS menu bar items. Keep labels short — these are menu items. The 'menu*' keys are OS-level menu bar category names (File, Edit, View, Help) — use the conventional names for the target OS locale. The 'tray*' keys are system tray icon menu items.
contextMenu.newNote: Context menu: create a new note.
contextMenu.newChildNote: Context menu: create a child note under the selected note.
contextMenu.newSiblingNote: Context menu: create a sibling note at the same level.
contextMenu.newRootNote: Context menu: create a root-level note.
contextMenu.duplicate: Context menu: duplicate the selected note.
contextMenu.paste: Context menu: paste a cut/copied note.
contextMenu.copyPath: Context menu: copy the note's path to clipboard.
contextMenu.share: Context menu: share this note with another user.
contextMenu.acceptShare: Context menu: accept an incoming share (opens acceptShareDialog). Must match the menu item name referenced in shareDialog.acceptInstruction.
contextMenu.acceptShareHere: Context menu: accept a share and place it under the selected note.
contextMenu.findInNotes: Context menu: search within the selected note's subtree.
contextMenu.find: Context menu: open the find-in-note search.
contextMenu.shareOffers: Context menu: view pending incoming share offers.
contextMenu.darkMode: Context menu toggle: switch to dark mode.
contextMenu.about: Context menu: open the About panel.
contextMenu.changeUsername: Context menu: go to change username settings.
contextMenu.changePassword: Context menu: go to change password settings.
contextMenu.deleteAccount: Context menu: go to delete account settings.
contextMenu.plan: Context menu: go to plan/subscription settings.
contextMenu.setPin: Context menu: go to PIN code settings.
contextMenu.loginSwitchUser: Context menu: go to login (when logged out) or switch user.
contextMenu.createAccount: Context menu: go to create account screen.
contextMenu.createPassword: Context menu: go to create password screen (local → cloud).
contextMenu.quit: Context menu: quit the application entirely.
contextMenu.goOnline: Context menu: switch from offline mode to online.
contextMenu.wordWrap: Context menu toggle: enable/disable word wrap in the editor.
contextMenu.updateAvailable: Context menu item shown when an update is available — acts as a notification.
contextMenu.markAsRead: Context menu: mark a notification as read.
contextMenu.checkForUpdates: Context menu: manually trigger an update check.
contextMenu.addGettingStarted: Context menu: add the Getting Started note set to the tree.
contextMenu.emptyRecycleBin: Context menu on the Recycle Bin node: empty it.
contextMenu.passwordGenerator: Context menu: open the standalone password generator dialog.
contextMenu.properties: Context menu: open the note properties panel.
contextMenu.workOffline: Context menu toggle: switch to offline mode.
contextMenu.trayShow: Tray menu: show the main window.
contextMenu.trayAllowScreenSharing: Tray menu toggle: allow note content to be visible in screen captures.
contextMenu.trayKeepTrayVisible: Tray menu toggle: keep the Windows System Tray (systray) icon visible.
contextMenu.trayShowInTaskbar: Tray menu toggle: show app in taskbar.
contextMenu.trayLaunchOnStartup: Tray menu toggle: launch on OS startup.
contextMenu.exportNotes: File menu item (Electron desktop only): export all notes to the filesystem as .md files. Keep short — it is a menu label.
contextMenu.exportNotesComplete: InfoDialog message shown after a successful export. Variable: {count} = number of .md files written. Use natural phrasing; the dialog title is the same as 'exportNotes'.
contextMenu.importNotes: File menu item (Electron desktop only): import notes from a folder of .md files. Keep short — it is a menu label.
contextMenu.importNotesComplete: InfoDialog message shown after a successful import. Variable: {count} = number of .md files read. Use natural phrasing; the dialog title is the same as 'importNotes'.
contextMenu.importNotesEmpty: InfoDialog message shown when the selected folder contains no supported text files (.md/.txt) to import. The dialog title is the same as 'importNotes'. Keep the file extensions '.md/.txt' as-is.
contextMenu.importedRootNoteTitle: Title of the root note created during import. Variable: {date} = local date-time string in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS format. Translate only the word meaning 'Imported'; keep {date} as-is.
contextMenu.menuMimiriNotes: OS app menu (macOS): the application name menu.
contextMenu.menuFile: OS menu bar: File menu name.
contextMenu.menuEdit: OS menu bar: Edit menu name.
contextMenu.menuView: OS menu bar: View menu name.
contextMenu.menuHelp: OS menu bar: Help menu name.
